# reset

Mailbox reset - put everything back where the connector found it.

Reset is what makes the watcher allowed to move mail at all: a filing is
reversible because the ledger recorded it and this package can undo it.
It is a developer/test fixture today and the product's undo tomorrow
(Sprint 1 names reset as the reason the move prohibition was lifted).

Key Components:
    - fixture: the reset orchestration and the Gmail half of restore.
    - graph: the Microsoft Graph half of the restore.

Pattern/Convention:
    Reset reads the ledger, never its own memory of what happened; a move
    the ledger did not record is a move reset must not invent. Both halves
    stay behind the same orchestration so a two-provider reset cannot
    half-run silently.

Example:
    >>> from inbox_zero_connector.services.reset import fixture
    >>> fixture.__name__
    'inbox_zero_connector.services.reset.fixture'

See Also:
    - inbox_zero_connector.services.audit.ledger: the record being undone.
    - inbox_zero_connector.services.watch: the writer of the moves.
